```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes"))) |>
  add_position_group(collect(select(tbl(con, "roster"), playerId, season, position))) |>
  filter(group != "Position not recorded")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
rates <- risk |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(seasons = n(), drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    drafted = drafted_ev / seasons,
    lo = 100 * vapply(seq_along(seasons), \(i) wilson(drafted_ev[i], seasons[i])[["lo"]], numeric(1)),
    hi = 100 * vapply(seq_along(seasons), \(i) wilson(drafted_ev[i], seasons[i])[["hi"]], numeric(1))
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(drafted)) |>
  mutate(
    group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)),
    role = case_when(
      row_number() <= 3 ~ "Leading three",
      group == "Quarterback" ~ "Quarterback",
      TRUE ~ "Other groups"
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(rates, aes(100 * drafted, group_f)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = role,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons; 95%% CI %.1f%% to %.1f%%)",
        group, 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons), lo, hi
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(x = hi + 0.1, label = pct(drafted)), hjust = 0, size = 5.5) +
  expand_limits(x = max(rates$hi) + 1.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Leading three" = "#374151", Quarterback = "#D95F02", "Other groups" = "grey65"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Drafted rate by position group",
    subtitle = "Leading three in dark grey, quarterbacks in orange; lines are confidence intervals, which overlap at the top",
    x = "Eligible seasons drafted",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "drafted-rate-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-class
rate_class <- risk |>
  group_by(group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(seasons = n(), drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(drafted = drafted_ev / seasons)
p_class <- ggplot(rate_class, aes(draft_year, 100 * drafted, colour = group)) +
  geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = group, tooltip = group), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = group,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, %d class: %.1f%% drafted (%s of %s eligible seasons)",
        group, draft_year, 100 * drafted, fmt(drafted_ev), fmt(seasons)
      )
    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(risk$draft_year), max(risk$draft_year), 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Drafted rate by position group and draft class",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible seasons ending in a draft pick",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Eligible seasons drafted (%)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a line to isolate a group; hover a point for the counts."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
card_interactive(p_class)
```
